text:
GruntWorx should inherit Instead’s operational safeguards and shared TaxDome vocabulary. Its API limits, polling windows and identity rules need separate confirmation.

1. **Rate limits need two budgets: per connection and across the app.** Instead throttles by API group and connection, then applies the app-wide budget. Ordering matters: a job rejected by its group must not consume an app slot. Production currently allows **3,000 requests/minute app-wide and 60/minute for `docs`**; development defaults are 500 and 5. Unknown groups fall into a budgeted `default` bucket.

   Preserve `Retry-After` support for both seconds and HTTP dates, plus remaining-budget/reset metrics. Ordinary operations have **10 retries**, but throttling reschedules work with the retry count reset—this is **not a wall-clock deadline**. GruntWorx should subclass the vendor-neutral worker and declare its own buckets. Sources: [throttle](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/initializers/sidekiq.rb:100), [production limits](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/settings/production.yml:187), [retry policy](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:9).

2. **Webhooks need a bounded reconciliation backstop.** Instead’s sweep runs every **30 minutes**, selecting uploaded documents still `sent` after **1 hour** or `processing` after **12 hours**, within a **2-day window measured from `uploaded_at`**. These thresholds support provider overrides. Older records are left unchanged; expiry of the window does not mark them failed.

   Instead lists paginated entity/year folders, then individually fetches candidates absent from the listing. An individual 404 becomes `archived`; absence from a folder alone does not. Reconciliation jobs make one attempt and rely on the next sweep; the sweep itself has three retries. Webhooks and polling share one status mapper, making duplicates harmless and refusing backward transitions. GruntWorx should inherit this recovery pattern, with its own evidence for thresholds and 404 semantics. Sources: [candidate bounds](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/queries/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_candidates_query.rb:8), [pagination and fallback](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_statuses_worker.rb:45), [individual lookup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_status.rb:36).

3. **Translate failures into a stable product vocabulary.** The shared reasons are `unexpected`, `no_active_connection`, `network_error`, `unauthorized`, `api_error`, `exceeded`, `forbidden`, and `encrypted`. Instead maps `password_required` to `encrypted`; an unknown indexing reason produces `error` without an invented reason.

   Keep temporary throttling separate from terminal quota exhaustion. Classify permanent refusals separately from retryable failures, and report contract/configuration errors operationally. Use the same mapping for callbacks and reconciliation so the UI receives consistent results. Sources: [shared vocabulary](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:12), [refusal classification](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/refusals_helper.rb:8), [Instead mapping](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/apply_processing_status.rb:10).

4. **Signed-upload cassettes need both sanitization and correct time.** Recording hooks scrub S3 policy, credential and signature fields and OAuth client secrets from request/response bodies. Instead bearer headers and token fields receive additional host-scoped scrubbing. GruntWorx must extend that credential handling for its own host and payload formats.

   Tagged replays freeze time at the cassette’s first recording timestamp, keeping recorded `ExpiresAt` values meaningful. New recordings use the real clock, and replay restores it afterward. Preserve expiry tests separately; a cassette passing under frozen time does not establish that expired targets are rejected. Sources: [recording sanitization](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/spec_helper.rb:164), [replay clock](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/support/vcr_fixed_time.rb:3), [clock expectations](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/unit/vcr/vcr_fixed_time_spec.rb:12).

5. **Entity matching must prefer ambiguity over a wrong link.** Instead searches only **active, unlinked entities within the firm and required entity type**, linking only a unique match. It normalizes case, punctuation and whitespace. Business matching also normalizes legal-form spellings and `&`/`and`, while rejecting names consisting solely of a legal form.

   Person matching uses first/last names; the account name is eligible only for a sole-contact account. Swapped names are tried only when the primary search finds nothing. Multiple matches remain unlinked, and outcomes are measured. Carry these conservative rules into GruntWorx, adapting normalization to its identity model. Source: [entity matching](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/link_entity_by_name.rb:47).

This assessment is based on source and test inspection; no files were edited and no tests were run.
